narrative: An employee was cleaning out dough at a conveyor belt. The belt caught the employee's left arm, causing it to strike a roller assembly. The arm was broken.

An employee had been filling water tanks on top of a flatbed trailer. The employee jumped three feet to the ground from a ladder on the truck. When he landed, his right ankle twisted and he fell, resulting in fractures to his right leg and ankle.
An employee was walking up to a patient's home to begin working when the neighbor's dog lunged off the porch and attacked her. Her wrist was fractured when the dog grabbed her arm.

An employee was starting up a reel on a wire packaging machine when a loop in the wire wrapped around his pinky finger. As the reel was turning to wrap around the drum, the loop tightened around his pinky finger and lacerated it, resulting in a pinky fingertip amputation.
An employee working on a scaffold breaking off rebar by hand lost his balance and fell over the wall 13 feet to the ground.

The employee was loading parts onto a rotating conveyor system when the machine malfunctioned and the parts got wedged in the machine. When the employee reached into the running machine to remove the parts, his finger was pinched resulting in the amputation of the left index finger to the first knuckle.
An employee was forming parts on a brake press when his right index finger was partially amputated.

An employee was attempting to change out rubber belts on a fine screw system when he slipped and fell from the fine screw system approximately 10 feet to the concrete floor. The employee was hospitalized for contusions and lacerations to the jaw and shoulder.
An employee was operating a pallet jack in a refrigerated warehouse. The pallet jack malfunctioned and backed into racking. The employee sustained a broken pelvis.
An employee was helping a customer put a tarp on the back of a pickup truck. She jumped from the back of the truck onto the ground and fractured her right tibia.
An employee was descending an extension ladder at a construction site when he fell approximately 15 feet to the ground below, suffering fractures and lacerations.
An employee reached under a conveyor belt and injured the pinky finger.
An employee was sanitizing a chocolate enrober. As he attempted to unjam the chocolate pump, the pump started and amputated his left index fingertip.
An employee was cutting a metal washer with a torch when a piece of the washer fell on and broke the employee's arm.
An employee was disconnecting the existing power source to the cardboard balers when the employee received an electric shock, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was restraining a cat in preparation for sedation when the cat bit the employee's hand, resulting in hospitalization due to an infection.
An employee fell in a parking lot while trying to stop a shoplifter. The shoplifter then ran over him with a vehicle, breaking his leg.

An employee was attempting to clear a clog in the rotary air lock of a central vacuum with his fingers. The first and second fingertips on his right hand were amputated, with no bone loss, in the dryer area.

On June 13, 2023, an employee was assisting with placing equipment onto a flatbed truck. The employee was on the bed of the truck directing the movements of a skid steer that was loading a 5-inch collar weighing approximately 500 pounds. The employee stepped forward to assist with moving the collar off the forks when the collar rolled on top of the employee's foot, causing compartmentalized swelling that required hospitalization and incisions to relieve the pressure.
On March 24, 2018, an employee was changing a die on a punch press when the machine actuated, amputating the employee's right index finger. The press was not powered off at the time of the incident.
An employee twisted his left ankle while walking.

An employee was closing an electric overhead door when he heard a noise in the door. The employee hit the stop button and the door came off the tracks. The door fell and part of the door struck the employee's right leg fracturing the lower leg.

An employee was riding a horse when it saw or smelled a mountain lion and spooked, bucking twice. On the first buck, the employee's face smashed into the crown of the horse's head. On the second buck, the employee was thrown to the ground. The employee suffered blunt force trauma to the facial area, including a broken jaw, sinus damage, and three broken bones near the right eye. The employee also sustained a broken right wrist upon hitting the ground.

Three employees were cutting and removing a tree limb. One of them was holding a pulley rope that was attached to the limb. After the limb was cut, it swung and struck his upper body. He suffered a broken right arm and dislocations to both shoulders.
An employee was operating a riding mower on a hillside when the mower flipped over and struck the employee's right hand. The hand was lacerated and one or more fingertips were amputated.

An employee wearing a blasting hood was preparing to blast inside a tank. The line that supplies the hood with breathing air was plugged into an argon line. The employee breathed the argon gas and fell. The employee was hospitalized for argon poisoning.

The injured employee was pounding rebars into the ground for a concrete form. Another employee bumped into the injured employee causing them to fall forward onto rebar. The rebar impaled the injured employee on the side of his neck.

A 12-foot steel plate fell while being lifted with a crane. The head of the plate caught an employee's hand, crushing the hand and the index and middle fingers. The tip of the employee's index finger was surgically amputated.

An employee was in an elevator toward the rear of the car when a mason began to enter the elevator with an electric pallet jack that was loaded with a pallet of bricks. The mason lost control of the loaded pallet jack and struck the employee in the stomach, pinning him between the bricks and the rear elevator gate. He was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning the top of a 19-foot tank. The top gave way and he fell to the bottom, suffering fractures to a lower-back vertebra and four toes on the right foot.

An employee was walking through the corrugated raw materials area when they were struck by a forklift that was moving in reverse. The employee sustained fractures to their left ankle and two of their toes.

An employee was cleaning out a broaching machine at the end of a shift. The machine actuated, causing amputations to the employee's index finger (to the first knuckle) and ring finger (just above the second knuckle).

An employee was using an outrigger for balance while he used his foot to clear snow from the area where the outrigger foot would sit. While the employee's hand was on the outrigger, the outrigger activated. The employee's right index finger that was inside a pin hole when it moved resulting in amputation.

An employee was delivering mail from her vehicle. She pulled over to reload mail from the back of the vehicle to the front of the vehicle. As she dismounted her vehicle, she fell on uneven gravel and twisted her ankle. Her left ankle broke and required surgery.
Employees were using a rotating rod to wrap up a pit cover from a frack site when an employee's pant leg got caught in the rotation, causing their leg to be broken in three places.

An employee pulled a cart with a Christmas tree on it to a customer's vehicle. She put the Christmas tree down to be loaded and was turning to leave when her foot was caught in the tree stand. This caused her to trip and fall onto her right side on the concrete walkway. She broke her right hip.

An employee was checking the drive bracket on a conveyor when the conveyor activated. His left thumb tip was caught and amputated in the conveyor chain. The conveyor was unguarded and not locked out at the time of the incident.

An employee was climbing a wooden ladder with a string of lights over his shoulder. When he reached the top of the ladder, he attempted to grab the rail but missed and fell approximately 20 feet, lacerating the side of his face and head and breaking his wrist.
An employee was using a pry bar to loosen a stuffing box when the tip of the bar slipped and amputated the employee's fingertip.
A maintenance employee was cleaning a drain and was burned on the face by the cleaning chemicals.
At 4:00 p.m. on September 7, 2021, an employee stepped on a nail that punctured his right foot. He was hospitalized, requiring surgery to remove the nail.
An employee's foot was run over by a pickup truck resulting in a broken foot and hospitalization.
An employee was stepping out of a truck when he missed the last step and fell to the ground, hitting his head.
An employee was cutting a wooden board when the saw kicked back and lacerated his left thigh, requiring hospitalization.
An employee tripped and fell while delivering mail, suffering a broken hip.
Employees were hoisting a garbage chute with a crane. The chute broke free, striking two employees. One employee was hospitalized for numerous injuries.

An employee was securing the lift gate on the rear of a delivery truck when his glove became stuck in the lift gate, trapping his finger between the truck and lift gate. His fingertip was amputated from the top knuckle to the tip. He was hospitalized for treatment.
Two employees were taken to the emergency room at Denver General for oxygen and observation after being exposed to carbon monoxide from a propane heater being used indoors.
While walking out of an office an employee tripped over a chair leg, fell to the floor, and broke their right hip.
An employee was hooking up a trailer when they were struck by lightening. The employee sustained burns to the back and hands.
An employee was stung by a bee and suffered an allergic reaction.

The lima bean combine harvester was having infeed problems. An employee climbed up on the machine head to observe the problem. The harvester operator was unaware the employee was there and raised the machine head. The employee was struck/pinched by the machine head fracturing three ribs.
An employee was driving a logging truck when it went off the road and flipped on its side. The employee suffered a broken arm and broken ribs and was hospitalized.
A cat bit an employee's right hand and finger. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was slicing meat in the kitchen when the slicer lacerated her finger. The employee then had a stroke and was hospitalized.
An employee tripped over a chair while walking out of his office, fell, and suffered a broken hip.

At about 11:30 p.m. on March 11, 2020, an employee was setting up a drawbench machine to pull aluminum wire. The employee's right ring finger was caught between the wire and the capstan wheel, and the fingertip was amputated.

An employee was attempting to wrap a finished coil. There is paper suspended above employees when they wrap coils, and the paper is included in the wrapping on the part. The employee's hand became caught between the coil and the wrapper roll. The wrapping machine cycled and crushed the employee's left hand. The employee was hospitalized, and surgery was required.
An employee was descending stairs during a fire alarm. The employee developed asthma-related shortness of breath and was hospitalized.
An employee was slicing pepperoni on a deli slicer and lacerated his thumb, resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was punched by another employee causing them to fall to the floor and hit their head. The employee sustained a brain bleed.
An employee was changing a drill bit. The drill activated, caught the employee's glove, and pulled in the employee's hand, amputating the little fingertip.
An employee was walking down the hall when her foot caught the floor causing the employee to fall on her left knee and right arm. She broke her knee and was admitted to the hospital.

On January 13, 2022, an automobile was driven onto a four-post lift to raise the automobile in the air. A service technician engaged the Swing Air Jack in order to elevate the rear tires of the automobile above and off the lift. When the employee engaged the hydraulics to raise the automobile with the Swing Air Jack, the Swing Air Jack unexpectedly released horizontally and toward the employee who was struck in the face. The employee was rendered unconscious and was hospitalized for a concussion, brain bleed, and broken facial bones.

An employee was ripping a 2/4 plank on a table saw. As he reached to grab the 2/4 plank, the saw blade lacerated his right index finger and thumb, requiring hospitalization. The saw blades were unguarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was climbing down an extension ladder when he lost his footing and fell feet first to the ground. The employee's ankles were injured.
An employee tripped and fell over a cord while walking to the rear of a deli slicer, fracturing the right tibia and fibula and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was in a scissor lift installing metal trusses on a building when he fell approximately 15 feet from the lift, breaking multiple bones.
An employee was shutting down a breaker when he contacted a 227-volt live wire and was electrocuted.
An employee was training on a pallet jack when their hand was caught between the pallet jack and a pallet. The employee sustained a crush injury to a finger and was hospitalized.
An employee inadvertently struck a wall-mounted fire extinguisher, which then dislodged from the wall and struck the employee's left hand, fracturing the pinky finger and requiring surgery.

On November 14, 2023, at 10:45 p.m., an Ace Roofing employee was climbing a ladder to perform a roof inspection. The ladder slipped on wet and icy ground and the employee fell 10 to 12 feet to the ground. The employee sustained a collapsed lung and fractures to vertebrae and ribs.
An employee was helping to lower an aircraft hose hoist when he tripped on a cart tongue that connects two engine cowling carts. He fractured his right elbow in two places.
An employee was bent over, picking up stacks of boxes from the floor to put into a carriage. He picked up multiple boxes and turned and felt a pop in his back. He was hospitalized with a back strain.
An employee had been lifting boxes and placing them into a cart for 5 hours when she strained her back, requiring hospitalization.
An employee tripped over a box and suffered a broken hip, requiring hospitalization.

Two employees were unboxing stadium chairs. Employee 1 picked up a paddle-lock and hit the injured employee in the head with it. The injured employee was knocked out, began having seizures, and was hospitalized with severe head trauma.
While riding an ATV, an employee hit a rut and was thrown from the vehicle. He struck the dirt road and sustained broken ribs, a collapsed lung, and broken neck vertebrae.
An employee was in the bed of a truck when they fell to the ground, resulting in a laceration and left arm fracture.
An employee was vacuuming a car. A second car behind the car the employee was vacuuming rolled over the employee's leg and fractured it.
An employee was pen riding when he fell from his horse. He was hospitalized for a skull fracture and intracranial bleeding.
On May 12, 2018, an employee was stepping off the side platform on the passenger side of a yard truck when his right leg struck against the metal step, fracturing his tibia. He was hospitalized.
An employee was operating the shaper that bevels the edges of small pieces angled to fit into a garage door and contacted the shaper blade amputating a fingertip.
An employee was pushing a cart that had gotten stuck when his right ring finger was pinched between the cart and racking. The fingertip was amputated without loss of bone or fingernail.
An employee fell from the second rung of a ladder while changing ceiling tiles, fracturing the right ankle.

An employee was trimming a pecan tree with a hand saw. He had climbed the tree and was pulling a limb back to cut it when the limb contacted power lines. The employee was shocked and suffered burns to both hands and both knees.

An employee was exiting his vehicle in the parking lot when he slipped on a patch of ice. When his left foot hit dry payment, the momentum of his body torqued his foot, causing his left ankle to fracture.
An employee was using a saw to cut an 8-inch PVC fire-waster line pipe when the pipe moved, causing the saw to kick back and lacerate the left side of the employee's chest.
An employee was performing pest control activities at a private residence. The employee reached into bushes next to the house and was bitten by a venomous snake.

An employee was removing a bucket cylinder from a backhoe. As the employee removed a pin, the cylinder link fell and struck the employee's right ring finger, causing a partial amputation to the fingertip.
An employee was lifting an approximately 20-pound glass rack for a dishwasher when the employee's back seized up, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was cutting a veal shank using a bandsaw when the shank bone slipped. The employee's thumb was then cut by the bandsaw, resulting in a partial right thumb amputation.
An employee was walking when she tripped over an ergonomic mat and fell, resulting in a broken left tibia.
On February 9, 2022, an employee was standing behind a tree while it was being cleared out by a skid steer. The employee was struck by a snapping tree and their left leg was broken in two places.

An employee was performing nursing rounds and caregiving activities for patients at the psychiatric unit of the hospital. A patient pulled the fire alarm in an attempt to escape, and threw water on the floor behind him as he was running. The employee ran after the patient, caught him, and brought him back to the unit. The patient became combative and bit the employee's finger and both of them slipped on the water and fell to the floor. Once the patient was secured back in their room, the employee went to the emergency room for a laceration he sustained when the patient bit his finger. The employee was then hospitalized for a heart attack.

On January 17, 2020, an employee was working on a double bender. While the first bend was being made on a piece of metal, the bending pin broke and struck the employee on the right side of his face, lacerating it.

On March 21, 2020, an employee was cleaning the rollers on a pasta machine when his smock was caught and his arm was pulled into the machine. The rotating blade inside the machine amputated the employee's arm below the elbow.

A truck and trailer were backing toward a loading dock. An employee was signaling for the truck to reverse and got caught between the truck trailer and the dock, suffering a broken pelvis. The injured employee was hospitalized.
An employee was wrapping a roll on a packaging crater when his right middle finger and ring finger were caught between a chain guard and a wind-up roller switch. His middle fingertip was amputated.
On or about August 3, 2016, the wire rope on a rigging system broke, allowing a hinge pin to fall about 20 to 30 feet and strike an employee's left arm.
An employee was standing on a step stool to refresh a kitchen display. After stepping off the step stool, he began walking, felt a pop in his right leg, and experienced leg pain. He was hospitalized.

Employee 1 was in front of an electric pallet jack picking groceries from shelving. Employee 2 was in front of Employee 1 with a pallet jack doing the same. Employee 1 thought Employee 2 was going to move forward, but Employee 2 didn't. Employee 1 kept moving forward with his pallet jack and got wedged between the two pallet jacks breaking his ankle.

An employee was riding a horse on a trail to provide information and directions to park visitors. As the employee and horse were transitioning down a slope and to the left, the employee fell off the horse onto the trail. The employee sustained swelling and bruising to the spine, a neck injury, and lacerations and contusions.
While doing steel erection work, an employee fell 20 feet to the ground, breaking both heels. He was not tied off at the time.
An employee was hospitalized with chest pains, headache, and nausea due to hydrogen sulfide exposure.

An employee was setting up to move chemical from a tank to a drum when a hose came loose and chemical splashed on the employee, burning the upper left arm and left side of the body. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was walking on a rooftop, placing a telecommunications wire. The employee fell through a fiberglass roof lighting panel and landed about 20 feet below on a concrete floor. The employee suffered a head laceration requiring staples, a concussion, multiple rib fractures, a punctured lung, multiple abrasions, and a broken bone in the hip/pelvic area.
A person fell on an employee who was sitting on a bean bag. The employee suffered injuries and was hospitalized.

An employee was on top of a molding machine, trying to start it, when the safety bar activated and smashed his right ring fingertip. He was hospitalized and had surgery to remove the finger above the first knuckle.

On May 09, 2017, an employee had dismounted a tugger and was hooking carts onto it when a second tugger passed by. The second tugger's carts broke loose and struck the employee. The employee was knocked to the ground and suffered a laceration on the right foot and a fracture to the right knee.

An employee was on a roof assisting with uploading materials and was also giving signals to a forklift operator. Insulation slid on the forklift's forks and struck the employee who then fell off the roof 12 feet to the ground. The employee suffered a back injury and a cut above his left eye.
An employee approached a suspected shoplifter in the parking lot to verbally deter him and was punched and kicked in the body by the shoplifter.
A border agent was performing a vehicle stop when someone left the vehicle and tried to escape. The employee suffered a broken ankle while chasing this person through rough ground.
On 3/9/16, at 8:06 p.m., an employee injured his right hand while breaking up a fight between inmates. The employee's hand became caught in an inmate's mouth during the altercation.

A temporary employee was driving a tugger to retrieve a case of product when he stepped off the tugger and suffered a left leg laceration, requiring hospitalization. The tugger had not stopped moving at the time of the incident.
An employee was attempting to free a plastic bag that had become jammed in the bagging machine and suffered a partial amputation of the right index finger.
An employee as using compressed air to blow water from a urinal's water line when the pressure caused the urinal to break. A piece of broken porcelain then lacerated his right elbow.
An employee was operating a flexible-shaft grinder. Fan blades inside the machine's motor caused the partial amputation and non-displaced fracture of his left middle finger.

A crew was building a scaffold inside a furnace. An employee was stabilizing the mudsill and jack as a 10-foot scaffold leg was being connected. The scaffold leg came in contact with the furnace wall, causing a piece of refractory brick to fall. It struck the right side of the employee's mid-back, causing a contusion.

An employee was picking up trash and putting it on the back of a truck. The employee rode on the back of the truck holding the trash while a coworker drove the truck to a dumpster a block away. The employee fell from the back of the truck to the road, suffering a head laceration and four broken ribs. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was riding as a passenger in a golf cart. The employee's right foot was hanging out the side of the cart when it struck a concrete wall/barrier, fracturing the right foot.
An employee was using an overhead crane to lift a half-inch steel plate off a plasma table. The plate shifted and fell, striking the employee's upper right leg and breaking it. He was hospitalized.

On March 14, 2019, an employee stepped on a 36" high pallet to observe a part stored on an upper rack. The employee slipped and fell from the pallet and the stored part fell and struck/grazed the employee's head, causing a skull fracture.
An employee had just filled the slug pot and lost balance while descending from the 2-step platform. The employee fell and broke their left arm.
An employee was cutting lumber with a skill saw. The sawblade lacerated his left hand.
An employee was in a warehouse, operating a powered industrial truck, when his left leg was caught between the truck and a support beam. The leg was amputated from the calf down.

An employee reached into a lathe near the point of operation to adjust a lubricant nozzle. His shirt became entangled on the rotating work piece and the employee was pulled into the lathe. He contacted the rotating chuck and received multiple cuts and lacerations and a loss of consciousness.
Employee using a table saw amputated his right index finger and his right middle finger.
An employee was trying to disconnect a high-level flow sensor that was going off in the acid farm area when acid contacted the employee's foot and lower leg, causing second degree chemical burns.

An employee was polishing a shaft using sand paper on a drill press. The employee's glove was caught in the drill press, resulting in an amputation to the left ring finger and torn tendons in the left index finger.

An employee was running a power washer when the tip became stopped up. The employee turned the washer off to unclog the tip, but pressure remained in the line. The clogged tip suddenly dislodged, and the residual pressure lacerated the employee's left index finger.
An employee was picking products when she tripped and fell, resulting in a fractured left femur that required hospitalization.
An employee was walking on a catwalk when he tripped on an object that protruded from the floor of the walkway and broke his left femur.

An employee was helping to lift tin panels off a flatbed truck. A spreader bar fell off the tines of a forklift and struck the employee, who fell backward onto the trailer. He suffered a broken left ankle, a contusion to the back/neck, and a laceration to the head.

An employee was walking along the edge of an excavation while the bucket was being changed on the excavator. The quick coupler slipped while releasing the bucket and the bucket slid down the spoil pile, knocking the employee into the ditch. The employee sustained a fractured bone in their back.
An employee was troubleshooting the conveyor and severed the distal tip of his right index finger when his right hand contacted the chain and gear.
An employee was cleaning a pressure cooker with a water hose. His left hand got caught in the rotating blade inside the machine and was amputated above the wrist.

An employee was operating a golf cart in which he was carrying boxed materials. When the employee made a turn, the materials shifted and the employee reached back with his left hand to stop the boxes from falling out. At the same time, the golf cart was over-steered, causing the employee to fall out and hit the ground. He broke his wrist and was hospitalized.
An employee was using a wire-pulling jack when the employee's left hand was caught in the piston jack and wire, breaking the pointer and middle fingers.
While stepping onto the track of a bulldozer, an employee sustained a bilateral quadriceps tendon rupture. He was hospitalized.
An employee was installing new teeth on a 15-inch blade on an edger machine when the machine was turned on and amputated their left foot above the ankle.

An employee was returning to her work area carrying a case of water bottles on her right shoulder. She was walking down a catwalk and came to a 4-step elevation change. As she walked down the steps, her left foot became entangled in some air hose, causing her to lose her balance. As she stepped down with her right foot to regain her balance, she stepped on more air hose, which caused her ankle to roll. When she brought her left foot back up, all of her weight went onto her right ankle. She dislocated her ankle and fractured her tibia and fibula.
An employee was lifting tarps off the ground and felt a pop. The employee was hospitalized for hernia surgery.
An employee was working behind pipe coating line equipment. He dismounted approximately 4.5 feet from his work platform and lost his footing. He lacerated and injured his shoulder, head, and arm.

An employee was operating a yard horse and was exiting the cab onto the platform of the yard horse when their safety boot got stuck on the platform grating causing the employee to fall approximately 42 inches from the platform onto the pavement. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured right elbow and vertigo.

One of the wheels of a semi-truck was trapped in a hole. The truck's driver asked an on-site employee to hook the truck to a yard dog so they could pull the truck's wheel out of the hole. The on-site employee hooked the truck to the yard dog and then boarded and operated the yard dog. As the yard dog began pulling, the brakes on the yard dog malfunctioned, causing it to move backwards. The driver of the semi-truck was standing between the semi-truck and the yard dog, and was crushed between the vehicles, sustaining two broken hips and a crushed pelvis.
An employee had left his truck to look at the road. A dog jumped a fence; as the employee turned to escape it, his foot got caught in the sand he was standing on. The twisting motion broke his femur.

An employee was in the SkyTrak personnel basket cutting tree limbs. The operator was repositioning the machine when it hit a mound of dirt and caused the SkyTrak to tip over. The employee jumped out of the basket and suffered a concussion and a broken right ankle.
An employee was lifting a patient when he began to feel abdominal pain and was hospitalized. The employee suffered a hernia.

An employee had finished his break. He then mounted a horse and was leaving the horse barn area. The horse began to buck and threw the employee to the ground. The employee sustained a separated shoulder, a left-side subdural hematoma, and a temporal fracture.
A maintenance employee completed a roof inspection and was descending a ladder. He fell from the fourth or fifth rung and fractured his pelvis and elbow.
A crowd was leaving an activity. A person started firing a handgun into the crowd. An employee who had been working at the front desk was shot in the back. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was installing electrical cables near the ceiling at a manufacturing facility. The employee was operating a scissor lift at a height of approximately 26 feet. While pulling the cable, a portion of the cable end became entangled on the lift and the lift overturned. The employee suffered left leg injuries that required surgery.

An employee was loading tools into a bucket truck. Upon stepping off the rear of the truck, he lost his footing and slipped. As he was falling, his right hand slid down the grab rail and got caught. The employee's right little finger was amputated.
An employee was getting labels off a shelf. They went to pull a fiber from a revolving conveyor roller. The roller pulled the fiber taut, causing the fiber to amputate the employee's left thumb pad.

An employee was using an electric winch to pull a boat onto a trailer. The boat moved and caused the employee to lose balance and grab the frame of the trailer with his left hand. At the same time, the rope quickly tightened and struck the employee's left hand, severing his left ring finger above the first joint.

An employee was walking and got their left foot caught on a portable set of steps that are along the bottom of the table on the north side. The employee attempted to break the fall and their right hand was caught in a machine amputating the right finger up to the first knuckle.

An employee was climbing up the ladder in an attempt to secure it when the ladder retracted and slipped off the wall. Both the ladder and employee fell to the ground. The employee fell approximately 8 feet, breaking ribs and suffering a swollen spleen.
An employee was cutting meat with a saw. The saw hit the employee's left thumb, causing a partial amputation.

An employee using a 10-foot A-frame ladder was knocked over when another employee opened a manual overhead door they were working on. The employee fell off the ladder and sustained multiple bone fractures on both forearms and wrists.
An employee in PIV training was operating a stand-up forklift. He backed into a metal rack, causing himself to be pinned between the PIV and the metal rack.
An employee fell backward off the back of a flatbed trailer, landing on the pavement about 5 feet below and suffering a broken elbow and humerus.
An employee suffered an electrical shock while plugging a cellphone cord into an outlet.
An employee partially amputated the right ring finger while slicing vegetables with a mandoline slicer.

An employee was helping to move an ice sculpture with two other people when the sculpture became imbalanced. He then felt a severe pain in his back. He was hospitalized with a lumbar herniated disc and back pain.

An employee was riding on a powered pallet jack near a sewer drain. The pallet jack hit a dip near the sewer drain, and the employee s left foot hit a clamp truck parked in a charging station. He suffered a cut to the big toe, as well as fractures in the toe and the foot.
An employee walked in front of a forklift and was knocked down by the forklift hitting his head on the ground.

An employee was completing a film change over on a bag maker machine. She engaged the machine to advance the film and as she realigned the film, her right middle finger became caught in the machine resulting in the amputation of the fingertip.
An employee was walking down stairs when they lost their balance and jumped three feet to the ground. The employee sustained two ankle fractures.

An employee was loading pigs weighing approximately 270 lbs. into a truck. The pigs were coming down the ramp in between the barn and the truck, when a hog got out, and struck the employee from behind causing a broken tibia.
An employee turned on belt washers to help the sanitation crew. A hose then whipped and the fitting on the end of the hose struck the employee's left leg resulting in a compound fracture.

An employee was operating a lawn tractor up a paved roadway when the tractor went into neutral and started rolling backward down the hill. The employee turned the wheel and the tractor flipped onto its side. The vehicle was equipped with a rollover protection system and the employee was wearing his seatbelt. When the tractor flipped on its side, the employee's fingertips were pinched between the ground and the tractor, resulting in a left middle fingertip amputation.
An employee was reaching around a conveyor when their finger was caught in a pulley, resulting in a partial left index finger amputation.

An employee was stripping epoxy spray finish from tile floors when he experienced difficulty breathing and vomited. He was hospitalized for chemical exposure. PPE was not worn at the time of the incident.

An employee was placing caps on the tank openings. A forklift struck the tank and the employee fell about 20 feet to the ground below. The employee's fall protection was not attached to the anchorage point.

On July 21, 2021, an employee was feeding reclaimed lumber into a wood jointer when his left ring finger contacted the machine's rotating cutter head, resulting in an amputation above the top knuckle.
On 08/23/2016, at 11:40 a.m., an employee was organizing accessories in a merchandise trailer when she fell off a step ladder and fractured her ankle.

An employee was operating a lip weld robot. When the robot began to cycle, a shim fell off the lug. As he was retrieving the shim, the robot cycled and pinched his left index finger between the lip plate and the lug. He suffered an amputation to the finger.
An employee was on the back of a traffic control trailer deploying traffic control devices when he fell to the ground and struck his head.

An employee was changing a blade on a utility knife/scrapper. As he was tightening the screw that holds the blade in place, the screwdriver slipped, causing his wrist to slide across the blade. He suffered a laceration and puncture wound on his wrist.

An employee was operating an electric pallet jack behind a floor scrubber when the scrubber stopped and the employee collided with the scrubber's back bumper bar. The employee sustained a fibular fracture to the lower left leg and was hospitalized.

On 1/20/2021, an employee was unloading a box truck with a pallet jack when he slipped on ice and struck his knee on the pallet jack. The employee suffered muscle detachment from his kneecap that requires surgery.

An employee was on a ladder, installing a toe line for a tubing lift. A weld on the structure broke, bringing it and the ladder down. The employee fell 15-20 feet to the ground, breaking ribs and a scapula.
An employee picked up a dumpster from a job site location and was strapping 2 x 6 wood on a roll-off dumpster truck with a bungee cord when the cord snapped and hit the employee's right eye.
On October 11, 2022, an employee was walking when she tripped on a cart wheel and fell onto the floor, resulting in a broken left arm and left hip. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.
An employee was doing maintenance work when a corrosive dip tank solution soaked into the employee's glove and caused burns to the hand.
An employee's hand and forearm contacted a blade used to cut chicken for marination. The employee sustained several lacerations.

An employee was using a shear to cut metal. A piece of metal became caught, then moved again and crushed the employee's right middle finger against the machine's guard. The employee suffered an amputation to the finger.
An employee was using a torque wrench while terminating a cable on or near a 120-volt DC battery. An arc flash from the battery burned the employee's hands.
An employee fell about 8 feet from a ladder and fractured his skull. He was hospitalized.
An employee's left hand was struck by a mixer blade while he cleaned the concrete mixer. His fingers broke and were badly scraped, requiring surgery.
An employee was about to polish a work piece using a grinding tool, with a Velcro-attached polishing pad. When the tool was started, the pad separated and hit the employee's left eye.
On June 17, 2022, at 3:28 PM, an employee was training another employee and adjusting the blade of the splitting saw when the saw started and amputated the employee's left ring fingertip.
An employee was using a bandsaw to cut a block of ice. The block jerked and drew the employee's hand into the saw, which amputated the employee's left little fingertip.
An employee was shot by a temporary employee while walking across the parking lot.
While removing aluminum flash from the die of a hydraulic trim press, an employee amputated his middle finger when the press malfunctioned.

On June 11, 2019, an employee was attempting to reach the edge of a metal roof when he slipped and fell approximately 15 feet to the ground. He sustained a fracture to his right wrist, multiple facial fractures (including his mandible), and a concussion. He was hospitalized. The employee's lanyard was unhooked at the time of the incident.
An employee's fingertip was amputated in a conveyor belt.

An employee was walking toward the injured employee when they tripped on loose floor tile in a supply room and fell on the injured employee. The injured employee sustained a left leg and knee fracture. The employee who fell was not injured.
An employee was closing the garage doors on a new construction project. Two of his fingers were caught in the door/rails, and the fingertips were amputated.
